author: Scikit-Plots Learn
description: A reusable evaluation review for machine-learning and data-science workflows.
empty_message: No one has applied Audit an evaluation for leakage and weak evidence to this topic yet.
instruction:
1. Identify the prediction target and decision the metric is meant to support.
2. Trace every preprocessing, feature-selection, calibration, and tuning step to confirm it is fitted only on permitted training data.
3. Check whether baselines and metrics answer the same task.
4. Look for class imbalance, repeated-subject leakage, temporal leakage, ceiling effects, and aggregation that hides subgroup behavior.
5. Report uncertainty or fold variability where available.
6. Replace the audit when the pipeline or dataset changes.
title: Audit an evaluation for leakage and weak evidence
